_network_type: Nested leave-one-group-out (LOSO/LOGO) comparison of a spiking autoencoder (SNN-AE, its architecture searched by NSGA-II) with its matched non-spiking control (ann-ae: the SNN winner's widths, a leaky ReLU where the SNN has a LIF), one OS process per (dataset, outer fold). PCA and the mean frame are added by 03_. The LSTM-AE, GRU-AE and Transformer-AE searched baselines were REMOVED 2026-11-02 (author's decision) on the evidence of a pre-validation on the development folds -- meeting01-prevalidation.json, scripts/pipeline/meeting01/00_meeting01_prevalidate_baselines.sh, .wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md 'Baseline pre-validation'. latent_dim is per-dataset since 2026-09-23 (dataset.sources[].latent_dim): audio (fsdd/audiomnist) 16, EEG (eegmmidb/siena) 64, literature-backed -- .wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md's 'latent_dim is fixed, not evolved' section has the citations.
_architecture_summary: SNN-AE: free encoder_widths genome (strictly decreasing, decoder mirrors encoder); LIF (LifBPTT, ArcTan surrogate, hard reset) in the encoder's hidden layers only, analog latent averaged over the T steps (T a gene, 2..32, since 2026-11-02), leaky-ReLU decoder run once (model.snn_time_pool / snn_decoder_neuron, 2026-11-01); R, C, V_th learnable, clamped 1e-6. Encoding (direct/poisson/latency) and the input transform (dense/conv1d/recurrent) are genes; latent_dim is fixed per dataset (never a gene). The search selects the winning genome from its rank-0 Pareto front on the inner validation group, retrains it on train+val (early-stopping on a recording-disjoint monitor carved from train) and evaluates it once on the held-out test group; ann-ae is then built from that winner's widths and goes through the same final fit and test.
_preprocessing: Non-overlapping 256-sample windows (32 ms @ 8 kHz for FSDD / AudioMNIST; 1.6 s @ 160 Hz for PhysioNet eegmmidb; 0.5 s @ 512 Hz for Siena Scalp EEG). Per-window z-score, then, for the SNN-AE, spike encoding over T REAL simulation steps (a gene, 2..32) -> a (T, 256) time-major tensor (row = t*B + b); ann-ae reads the analog window once. Encoding (direct/poisson/latency) is a GA gene, not an outer sweep. Both models are trained to reconstruct the ORIGINAL z-scored window once (the SNN-AE averages its steps before the decoder, model.snn_time_pool = latent), never its own spike code, so val_mse is comparable across encodings. Stratified per-fold window caps (loso_max_{train,val,test}_windows = 1000 / 150 / 1500) round-robin across recording_id so every speaker/recording stays represented; LOSO structure and the recording-level statistical unit are unchanged.
_total_runs_breakdown: Per (dataset, fold, run_id): ONE NSGA-II search (the SNN-AE), population x (1 + generations) = 8 x 6 = 48 evaluations + up to |Pareto front| x winner_seeds re-scorings + 1 retrained winner, then the ann-ae control (1 training). 4 datasets x 6 folds x 5 runs = 120 cells, one process per (dataset, fold) = 24 processes. NOT MEASURED at these settings: the 2026-09-23 calibration (SNN ~0.5 s per epoch at 200 training windows and T = 16, ~0.27 h per cell worst case; the three removed families ~45-74 h per cell each, ~172 h per cell in all) predates 1000 training windows, T up to 32 and the removal. The pre-validation (meeting01-prevalidation.json) records the SNN-AE search's wall time on the development folds at a reduced budget; 00_meeting01_prevalidation_report.py prints it next to the removed families'.
_dataset_config: Speaker/record-disjoint outer folds (6). No pooled sample caps (max_loaded_train_samples / max_validation_samples = 0 -> every window of the disjoint partitions, then the stratified loso_max_* caps apply). 30 epochs max, early stop patience 5, lr 0.001 (weights) / 0.0001 (R, C, V_th), batch size 1. Per-epoch progress on stderr as '[loso] ... epoch N/M' (survives nohup, where the live bars collapse).
_comment: Nested-LOSO SNN-AE vs matched-control grid for the meeting01 paper revision. Dataset grid changed 2026-09-23: mitbih (ECG) replaced by two EEG datasets, eegmmidb + siena (user request), both read via the EDF loader (Meeting01Eeg.{hpp,cpp}) -- see dataset.sources[] for root paths; siena substituted for an original chbmit choice the same day when CHB-MIT's 42.6GB did not fit available disk (siena is 20.3GB, same seizure-EEG task category, complete 14-subject dataset). Searched sequence baselines removed 2026-11-02 (see _network_type). Run via scripts/pipeline/meeting01/01_meeting01_run_loso.sh, or on GridUnesp as a 24-task array (submit_loso_array.sh); see _total_runs_breakdown for what is and is not measured about its cost. cv_fold here is a default; the run script overrides it per process with --cv-fold.

dataset._loso_max_train_windows_comment: 1000 since 2026-11-02 (was 200; author's decision): the format-5 design was diagnosed and validated at 1000 training windows per fold, and more windows improve every model (FSDD fold 0, C++, format 4: SNN-AE 0.880 -> 0.827, ann-ae 0.706 -> 0.662 from 200 to 1000) without closing the SNN-AE / ann-ae gap.
dataset._latex_data_dir_comment: Empty since 2026-11-02: the per-fold LaTeX exports (<tag>_summary.dat, _sweep.dat, _mse_plot.csv, ...) are files nothing reads -- the paper's data come only from 02_/04_/00_ -- and they landed in the paper's data/ next to the generated files, on the cluster as /home I/O. Output-only: not in config_hash, so a checkpoint survives the change.

sources.name: fsdd
sources._latent_dim_comment: 16 (16:1 vs the 256-sample window): short-speech/traditional AE and LSTM bottlenecks in the literature sit at 8-16 -- see .wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md.

sources.name: audiomnist
sources._latent_dim_comment: 16 (16:1): same short-speech domain as fsdd; AudioMNIST encoders in the literature sit in the 16-64 range -- see .wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md.

sources._comment: Source: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, https://physionet.org/content/eegmmidb/1.0.0/ (109 subjects, 64 channels, EDF+, one subdirectory per subject: S001/S001R01.edf ...). Downloaded 2026-11-01 (1526 EDF, 3.4 GB). Signal 0 of each .edf is read; verified 2026-11-04 against the headers of all 1526 files to be the EEG channel 'Fc5.', not an annotation/status channel: 1490 files at 160 Hz, 36 at 128 Hz (subjects S088, S092, S100). sample_rate is the rate all windows are cut at: each file is filtered at its own rate and converted (Meeting01Eeg.hpp).
sources.name: eegmmidb
sources._latent_dim_comment: 64 (4:1): no eegmmidb-specific AE paper found; extrapolated from Khan et al. 2023's shallow-AE result on CHB-MIT (a related but different seizure-EEG dataset, not used in this study) -- see .wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md.

sources._comment: Source: Siena Scalp EEG Database, https://physionet.org/content/siena-scalp-eeg/1.0.0/ (Detti 2020; 14 subjects, up to 35 channels, 512 Hz, EDF, one subdirectory per subject: PN00/PN00-1.edf ...). Signal 0 of each .edf verified 2026-09-23 against real downloaded headers to be an EEG channel ("EEG Fp1"), not a status/EKG channel. Replaces CHB-MIT (2026-09-23): CHB-MIT's 42.6GB total did not fit available disk; Siena is a complete dataset in the same task category (seizure scalp EEG) at 20.3GB.
sources.name: siena
sources._latent_dim_comment: 64 (4:1, same as eegmmidb -- window_size=256 is global, not per-sample-rate): no Siena-specific AE paper found; extrapolated from Khan et al. 2023's shallow-AE result on CHB-MIT (hidden_size=64; a separate {32,64,128} sweep on CHB-MIT also picked 64) -- same seizure-EEG task category as Siena, not a direct hit -- see .wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md.

training._early_stop_min_skill_comment: Patience (early_stop_patience) only counts once the monitor loss is at most (1 - this) x the loss of the mean-target predictor; until then the run cannot stop early, and the best monitor epoch's network is kept (results_format 7). 0.10: the deepest plateau excursion in the pre-validation's 216 trainings was a skill of 0.066. Rationale: lib/include/Meeting01Stopping.hpp.

model._latent_dim_comment: Fallback only: every dataset in evaluation.datasets below overrides this via dataset.sources[].latent_dim (16 audio / 64 EEG), so this value is never actually read by the LOSO grid -- kept as a sane default for ad-hoc single-dataset runs of this profile with --dataset omitted-override.
model._time_steps_comment: Not set here since 2026-11-02: T is a gene of the SNN-AE search (evaluation.ga.snn.time_steps_min/max), so model.time_steps would be a value no SNN reads. History: 16 until 2026-11-01, then 4 from FSDD alone; on eegmmidb fold 0 T = 16 beat T = 4 by ~0.05 (validation 0.372 vs 0.425), on FSDD T made no difference, so the author made T a free gene chosen on validation per fold.
model._snn_time_pool_comment: latent (2026-11-01): the SNN-AE averages its latent over the T steps and runs its decoder once. Gap diagnosis (.wiki/Experiments/Meeting01.md, 'Where the gap comes from'): scoring every step's output costs ~0.05 test MSE; averaging at the latent or at the output measured the same (0.724 vs 0.724 at T = 4), and the latent is T x cheaper in the decoder.
model._snn_decoder_neuron_comment: analog (2026-11-01): leaky ReLU in the decoder, the neuron ann-ae's decoder has, so the SNN-AE and the ann-ae control differ in the encoder's hidden neuron alone (LIF over T steps vs leaky ReLU once). Required by snn_time_pool = latent.
model._initializer_comment: xavier (2026-11-01) for the SNN-AE and, when it runs, its matched control ann-ae (validate() requires the field once ann-ae is a baseline). Left empty each builder kept its own -- kaiming SNN, xavier ANN -- so the control differed in its starting weights too. PyTorch twin, 3 seeds, test MSE kaiming -> xavier: eegmmidb fold 0 ANN 0.489 -> 0.293, SNN-AE (this design) 0.484 -> 0.449; FSDD fold 0 ANN 0.667 -> 0.654, SNN-AE 0.724 -> 0.729. Xavier is better or equal for both arms on both datasets; the ANN's kaiming deficit on EEG persists to convergence (200-epoch cap: 0.479 vs 0.291).

evaluation._baselines_comment: ann-ae added 2026-11-02 (author's decision): the matched non-spiking control -- the SNN-AE winner's own widths, a leaky ReLU where the SNN has a LIF, the same initializer and training -- is the comparison the paper is built on. It is not searched (it copies the SNN winner of the same dataset, fold and run). lstm-ae, gru-ae and transformer-ae removed 2026-11-02 (author's decision), justified by the pre-validation of meeting01-prevalidation.json on the development folds: cost of training, cost of inference and quality, each family through a reduced search of the same budget. The binary still has them; 02_ / 04_ list only the configured families.

snn._time_steps_comment: T, an integer drawn uniformly in [2, 32] (author's decision 2026-11-02: a free range, not preset values). 2 is the least validate() accepts (one step leaves alpha and the poisson/latency codes without a time axis); 32 is twice the largest T measured on EEG (16, the best there). The GA's cost objective (estimate_snn_macs) grows with T: every layer runs at every step, except that a direct-coded input through dense/conv1d has its first layer counted once (results_format 9, the energy_nj rule); it keeps cheaper genomes on the Pareto front, but the winner is the front's lowest re-scored validation MSE (cost only breaks ties), so a longer T is selected only when it validates better.
